sec: Thyroid embryology, surgical relations and thyroglossal remnants

items.q: The first endocrine organ to form is the ___, beginning at about ___ weeks of gestation.
items.exp: The source calls the thyroid the first endocrine organ formed, at 3–4 weeks. (Book p898)

items.q: Match the following developmental steps — 1) Germ layer 2) Initial site 3) Destination of descent … A) Endoderm B) Anterior to trachea C) Floor of primitive pharynx
items.exp: The follicular thyroid arises from endoderm in the primitive pharyngeal floor, descends anterior to the trachea and forms lobes. (Book p898)

items.q: A midline subhyoid neck swelling moves on swallowing and tongue protrusion. Which embryologic remnant is most likely?
items.exp: The chapter pairs thyroglossal cyst with midline subhyoid position and movement on deglutition and tongue protrusion. (Book p898)

items.q: In the source's simplified 'after 5 weeks' branch, persistence is linked to a cyst and the tongue remnant is the ___.
items.exp: The diagram labels the foramen cecum as the remnant; the exact involution timeline is simplified, so do not equate its 5-week heading with a universal completion date. (Book p898)

items.q: Which is the odd one out for a typical thyroglossal cyst in this chapter?
opts: Lateral swelling fixed during tongue protrusion
items.exp: The source emphasizes subhyoid position and mobility with swallowing/tongue protrusion; a fixed lateral swelling suggests a different differential. (Book p898)

items.q: An uncomplicated thyroglossal cyst is treated by simple incision, then develops persistent drainage. Which complication and preferred operation match the source?
opts: Fistula; Sistrunk excision with central hyoid segment
items.exp: The diagram warns that incision can produce a fistula and favors excision with the hyoid component by Sistrunk operation. (Book p898)

items.q: Assess: I The thyroid pseudocapsule is derived from pretracheal fascia. II Berry ligament is described here as a condensation of the carotid sheath.
items.exp: The source links the pseudocapsule to pretracheal fascia and describes Berry's ligament as its posterior condensation attached to the cricoid region. (Book p898)

items.q: Match the following vascular origins — 1) Superior thyroid artery 2) Inferior thyroid artery 3) Thyrocervical trunk … A) Thyrocervical trunk B) External carotid C) Branch of subclavian system
items.exp: The diagram traces superior thyroid supply from the external carotid and inferior thyroid supply through the thyrocervical trunk of the subclavian system. (Book p898)

items.q: A surgeon dissects the superior thyroid vascular pedicle near a nerve supplying the cricothyroid. Which nerve is at risk?
opts: External branch of superior laryngeal nerve
Internal branch of superior laryngeal nerve
items.exp: The vascular figure highlights the external superior laryngeal branch near the superior thyroid artery; the internal branch has a different course. (Book p898)

items.q: The laryngeal nerve labeled near the inferior thyroid artery is the ___ nerve.
items.exp: The inferior thyroid artery–recurrent laryngeal nerve relationship is a key surgical relation in the diagram. (Book p898)

items.q: For the neck illustration, evaluate: I Superior and recurrent laryngeal nerves are branches of the vagus. II The common and external carotid arteries are both labeled in the arterial tree.
items.exp: The diagram labels vagus, superior laryngeal branches, bilateral recurrent nerves and the carotid arterial system. (Book p898)

items.q: The radiographic caption shows a cyst below the hyoid. Which anatomical descriptor should be used?
items.exp: The image is explicitly labeled thyroglossal cyst in the common subhyoid position. (Book p898)

items.q: Assess thyroglossal cyst origin: I It is a congenital developmental remnant. II Congenital origin establishes a Mendelian inheritance pattern.
items.exp: Thyroglossal cysts arise from developmental duct persistence; congenital does not imply a defined inherited Mendelian syndrome. (Book p898)
